The '''[[1935 in association football|1935]]–[[1936 in association football|36]] season''' was the 44th season of [[The Football League]].

This season saw two significant changes in the First Division. Prior to this season [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa]] and [[Blackburn Rovers F.C.|Blackburn Rovers]] had been the only ever-present members of English football's top division since the [[1888–89 Football League|first edition]] in 1888–89. Both were relegated this season and ended their uninterrupted streaks.
